learning_outcomes.text: Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems.

Ability to identify the main problems and challenges of our society and to propose, design and develop sustainable, innovative and participatory methodologies and/or technologies to improve people's lives, making responsible use of resources and knowing how to determine the impact that different projects have on the economy, society or the environment.

syllabus_topics: Topic 0. Sustainable Development Goals - SDG9 Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure (Focus on Manufacturing Processes)
Topic 1. Introduction to Manufacturing and Production Systems
Topic 2. The Production System: Functional Structure

assessment_methods.method: Participation in complementary learning formative activities

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as the weighted average of the evaluation activities, provided that a minimum grade of 5.0 is achieved in PE1, PE2, and Laboratory practices. If one or more evaluation activities do not meet the minimum grade, the final course grade will be the average of all activities but cannot exceed 4.0. To pass, the weighted average must be no less than 5.0. In the extraordinary session, students only re-take the re-evaluable activities not passed, and the final grade is calculated using approved ordinary session grades and new re-evaluated grades.
